name: motion-debugger
description: Build premium, art-directed web pages with choreographed motion, then critique the real rendered page and refine it

interface.shortDescription: Premium motion design. Seen in a real browser.
interface.longDescription: A concrete premium-motion craft skill and drop-in motion kit, plus a browser critic that records entrance, scroll, hover, focus, mobile and reduced-motion behaviour and returns contact sheets with actionable fixes. Recorded-motion evidence tools remain available for detailed transition debugging.
defaultPrompt: Use $premium-motion to build this website with premium design and polished animation, then critique and refine it.
